versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: And from thence I went towards the west to the ends of the earth, and saw there three portals of the heaven open such as I had seen in the †east†, the same number of portals, and the same number of outlets.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh prema zapadu, do krajeva zemlje. Ondje vidjeh otvorena troja nebeska vrata, kao što sam vidio na †istoku†: isti broj vrata i isti broj izlaza.
